analysis_scope: read-only planning-moment diagnostic; no model fitting, no new policy or P&L search
native_arithmetic: float64 ratios of the same native float32 stored prices

equations.equal_risk_score: asset reward / daily standard deviation; an algebraic score, not portfolio P&L

summary.planning_scope: Means compare asset holding returns. A daily reoptimized multi-asset portfolio has different compounding, turnover and future holdings; no policy return computed here.

limitations: Previously reviewed historical data; no new out-of-sample evidence.
No financing/index mechanism attribution from arithmetic residuals.
Identical H5-mature dates are used for all moment comparisons; annual price-clock residuals use return-end calendar years.
No costs subtracted from moment means: costs depend on the existing position path, which this diagnostic does not replay.
Equal-volatility scores are algebraic moment normalizations, not portfolio backtests or a source for selected weights.
Published affine basis and 16 secondary Yahoo bars retain parent-source limitations.
